beats.en_subtitle: Three main day count conventions dominate fixed income: Actual/Actual, 30/360, and Actual/360.
beats.en_narration: Three institutional day count conventions govern fixed income: Actual/Actual in period, 30/360, and Actual/360.

leftCard.title: US Treasury Bonds
leftCard.subtitle: Actual / Actual (in period)
points: Counts exact actual calendar days between dates.
Divides by exact actual days in the semiannual coupon period (e.g. 181 or 184 days).
Accounts for leap years and exact calendar day differences.
Used for all US Treasury bonds and notes.

rightCard.title: Corporate & Municipal Bonds
rightCard.subtitle: 30 / 360 Convention
points: Assumes every full calendar month has exactly 30 days.
Assumes every year has exactly 360 days (12 months x 30 days).
Simplifies manual interest accounting for corporate issuers.
Used for US corporate bonds and municipal municipal debt.

data.contrast: Exact calendar days vs standardized 30-day months

semantics.teachingObjective: Contrast Treasury Actual/Actual rule against corporate 30/360 standard

subtitlePhrases.text: Three main day count conventions dominate fixed income: Actual/Actual,

beats.hindi_tts: ट्रेजरी बॉन्ड्स में कैलेंडर के असली दिन गिने जाते हैं। जबकि कॉर्पोरेट बॉन्ड्स में हर महीने को 30 दिन और साल को 360 दिन मान लिया जाता है।
beats.en_subtitle: Treasury bonds count exact calendar days. Corporate bonds assume 30 days per month and 360 days per year.
beats.en_narration: Treasury bonds count exact calendar days. Corporate bonds assume each month contains 30 days and the year contains 360 days.

leftCard.title: Actual / Actual Ratio
leftCard.subtitle: Interest Fraction
points: Let d = actual days elapsed since last coupon.
Let D = actual days in current coupon period.
Accrued Interest = (Annual Coupon / 2) x (d / D).
Perfect mathematical reflection of true elapsed time.

rightCard.title: 30 / 360 Ratio
rightCard.subtitle: Interest Fraction
points: Day count formula: 360(Y2 - Y1) + 30(M2 - M1) + (D2 - D1).
Denominator is always 180 for semiannual coupons.
February 28th and 31-day months are adjusted by special rule sets.
Slightly diverges from exact solar calendar time.

data.contrast: Actual/Actual exact fraction vs 30/360 standardized half-year

semantics.teachingObjective: Explain accrual ratio formulas across both conventions

subtitlePhrases.text: Treasury bonds count exact calendar days.

beats.hindi_tts: और मनी मार्केट इंस्ट्रूमेंट्स जैसे टी-बिल्स और कमर्शियल पेपर में एक्चुअल-बाय-360 नियम चलता है, जहां साल 360 दिन का माना जाता है।
beats.en_subtitle: Money market instruments like T-bills and commercial paper use Actual/360.
beats.en_narration: Furthermore, money market instruments such as Treasury bills, repo, and commercial paper use Actual/360 convention.

leftCard.title: Actual / 360 Money Market
leftCard.subtitle: T-Bills, Repo, Commercial Paper
points: Counts exact actual elapsed calendar days.
Divides by 360-day year denominator.
Effectively increases the annualized interest rate by 365/360 (approx 1.39%).
Standard across international money markets and interbank deposits.

rightCard.title: Market Implications
rightCard.subtitle: Yield Comparison Caveat
points: Traders cannot directly compare T-bill discount rates to T-bond yields.
Must convert money market rates to bond-equivalent yield (BEY).
Prevents mispricing when constructing zero curves.

Duration of futures contract contracts toward 15 years.
Dominates during low-rate central bank easing cycles.

Basis traders aggressively short the long bond basis.
